# 🧩 Documentation Templates

Use these templates when proposing future engineering or product work. Templates do not imply that the corresponding process or system exists today.

- [Architecture decision record](adr-template.md)
- [Feature specification](feature-specification-template.md)
- [Test plan](test-plan-template.md)
- [Incident report](incident-report-template.md)
- [Risk assessment](risk-assessment-template.md)

For every completed template, identify the author/owner, status, evidence, verification method, risks, and revision date.
